properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA mu ggulu,
Ggwe-otukuza byonna;
N'okwagala kwo-okw'ensusso
Tukuza-ennyumba-eno

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mwe tukakasibwa
Nga tubatizibwa,
N'okunaazibwako-ebibi,
-Olw'ekisa kyo-ekingi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Kristo ye kennyini,
Mw'aliisiza-ababe
-Omubiri n'Omusaayi ggwe,
Ye mmere y'obulamu-.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Abantu-aboonoonyi,
Mwe basaasirirwa;
Bonna-abfiira mu kibi,
Mwe basonyiyirwa.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Amaanyi g'omubi
Gawangulwa mangu;
Bwe gakoona ku nnyumba-eno,
Kubanga ntukuvu.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
-Ettendo libe-eri ggwe,
Kitaffe n'Omwana,
N'Omwoyo-Omutkuvu,
Emirembe gyonna.
